opening.argument: The presentation centers on a flash-loan method promoted as a way to generate unusually rapid returns. It explains how to implement a smart contract “to start earning” on Binance Smart Chain, claims viewers “will earn approximately. 200 to 300% profit,” and reports that “from a 0.4 BNB investment, I earned back 6.7 BNB.” It then directs viewers to connect MetaMask, send BNB to an address copied from Remix, and complete a transaction requiring another gas fee. The educational framing and statement that no particular outcome is guaranteed do not erase that promotional mechanism. The separate Ethereum giveaway is presented as subscriber engagement rather than part of that mechanism.
